name: Department of Philosophy
about: Founded in 1973, the department is one of the oldest in the Faculty of Arts and Humanities. It began with Bachelor (Honours) and MA degrees and later added MPhil and PhD programmes, with a focus on Western and modern philosophy.

name: Department of Islamic History and Culture
about: Founded in 1974 to produce graduates with specialised knowledge of Muslim history and culture. It started with a three-year Honours and one-year Master's programme.

name: Department of Persian Language and Literature
Department of Sanskrit
about: One of the university's oldest departments, it began on 31 October 1974 as part of the Department of Oriental Languages. It promotes Sanskrit language, literature, philosophy and Indological studies.

name: Institute of Modern Languages
about: The institute grew out of language courses the Faculty of Arts introduced in 1982. Its foundation was approved by the Syndicate on 12 August 2002, and it teaches English and other modern languages.

name: Department of Physics
about: One of the largest physics departments in Bangladesh, with 35 permanent academic staff and over 500 undergraduate and graduate students, supported by extensive workshop and technical facilities.

name: Department of Chemistry
about: Founded in 1968 under the Faculty of Science, the department first ran only an MSc programme; its BSc (Honours) course started in 1971.

name: Department of Mathematics
about: Established in 1968, the department has around 25 faculty members covering pure and applied mathematics, including mathematical physics, relativity, cosmology and operations research.

name: Department of Applied Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
about: Inaugurated in 2011, the department trains professional applied and environmental chemists, with the theme of contributing to eco-friendly industrial development.

name: Institute of Forestry and Environmental Sciences
about: Established in 1976 as the Institute of Forestry and renamed the Institute of Forestry and Environmental Sciences in 1996. It is on the university's south campus.

name: Department of Accounting
about: Its foundation was laid in 1968 and it started functioning in 1971 under the Faculty of Commerce, offering Bachelor and Master of Commerce. It is a major supplier of accounting graduates to the public and private sectors.

name: Department of Management
about: Started under the Faculty of Commerce following a 1970 Syndicate decision, the department pioneered the BBA programme in Bangladesh in 1988.

name: Department of Marketing
about: Launched on 1 November 1992 by ten faculty members, the department has over 700 students in its BBA, MBA, MPhil and PhD programmes.

name: Department of Human Resource Management
about: Established in 2013 to meet the demand for specialised expertise in people and organisational development.

name: Department of Banking and Insurance
about: Started in 2013 to build specialised expertise in banking, insurance and the financial sector. It offers a four-year BBA programme.

name: Department of International Relations
about: Established on 25 November 2004 with 11 students, the department studies diplomacy, international law, security studies and global governance.

name: Department of Communication and Journalism
about: Launched as the Department of Journalism on 8 December 1994 with two teachers and 23 students, and renamed Communication and Journalism in 2003.

name: Department of Criminology and Police Science
Department of Law
about: Established in 1992, the department admits 130 students a year to its LLB (Honours) programme through a competitive admission test, and also offers an LLM.

name: Department of Geography and Environmental Studies
about: Started as the Department of Geography on 4 June 1996 and renamed Geography and Environmental Studies in 2005. It has 18 faculty members and around 300 students.

name: Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
about: The department teaches and researches biochemistry and molecular biology; its graduates work in pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, health and agro-based industries.

name: Department of Soil Science
about: One of the prominent departments of the Faculty of Biological Sciences.

name: Department of Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology
about: A research-oriented, multidisciplinary department studying the molecular and genetic basis of life, with applications in agriculture, health, disease diagnosis and biopharmaceuticals.

name: Department of Psychology
about: The Department of Psychology was established in 2005 under the Faculty of Biological Sciences. It offers BSc (Honours), MS, MPhil and PhD programmes, with teaching and research in areas such as stress and health, ageing, community mental health and neuropsychological assessment.

name: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
about: The department launched its undergraduate programme in 2001 and its postgraduate programme in 2010. It has 22 faculty members and around 400 students.

name: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
about: The department launched its undergraduate programme in 2001 and its postgraduate programme in 2010. It has 23 faculty members and around 400 students.

name: Department of Physical Education and Sports Science
Department of Marine Sciences
faculty: Faculty of Marine Sciences and Fisheries

name: Department of Oceanography
faculty: Faculty of Marine Sciences and Fisheries
about: The first academic centre in Bangladesh dedicated to the advanced study of ocean and coastal systems, located near the Bay of Bengal.

name: Department of Fisheries
faculty: Faculty of Marine Sciences and Fisheries
about: Operating since 2018, the department offers fisheries education built on an internationally standard curriculum.

name: Department of Paediatrics
_note: Listed on the official faculty page, but its link goes to the homepage — no details published.
